source_processing: Initially, the raw multiome data comprising both gene expression and chromatin accessibility fragments were processed using 10x Genomics Cell Ranger ARC. The scRNAseq data from multiple samples were imported using import10xFeatureMatrix. For the ATAC modality, low-quality cells defined as those with TSS enrichment less than 5, fewer than 2,500 fragments, or missing RNA UMIs were filtered out. Cell barcodes were used to match and integrate scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data in ArchR, retaining only shared cells using subsetArchRProject(). Gene expression data were incorporated with matched RNA constraints, and iterative LSI was applied separately to both RNA and ATAC matrices for dimensionality reduction. A combined low-dimensional embedding was then generated followed by UMAP visualization and clustering. Differential gene activity gene score matrix and chromatin accessibility peak matrix were identified, peaks calling was performed using MACS2. Subsequently, motif enrichment analysis was conducted using ENCODE and HOMER annotations to identify transcription factor binding patterns across clusters.

title: Pt37_C1D3 scmultiome- scRNA
extract_protocol_ch1: From cryopreserved PBMCs, nuclei were isolated using the Chromium Nuclei Isolation Kit from 10X genomics (PN-1000493) based on the manufacturer's protocol.

Single nuclei suspensions were processed using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression (10x Genomics, PN: 1000283) platform following the manufacturer’s protocol, generating paired ATAC and gene expression libraries for each sample.
data_processing: Initially, the raw multiome data comprising both gene expression and chromatin accessibility fragments were processed using 10x Genomics Cell Ranger ARC. The scRNAseq data from multiple samples were imported using import10xFeatureMatrix. For the ATAC modality, low-quality cells defined as those with TSS enrichment less than 5, fewer than 2,500 fragments, or missing RNA UMIs were filtered out. Cell barcodes were used to match and integrate scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data in ArchR, retaining only shared cells using subsetArchRProject(). Gene expression data were incorporated with matched RNA constraints, and iterative LSI was applied separately to both RNA and ATAC matrices for dimensionality reduction. A combined low-dimensional embedding was then generated followed by UMAP visualization and clustering. Differential gene activity gene score matrix and chromatin accessibility peak matrix were identified, peaks calling was performed using MACS2. Subsequently, motif enrichment analysis was conducted using ENCODE and HOMER annotations to identify transcription factor binding patterns across clusters.
